PRICING

Naano pricing

Naano offers two ways to run LinkedIn creator campaigns. Self-Serve costs €0 per month: you get full platform access and pay creators at the fixed price shown on their offer. Managed Campaigns costs €700 per month and adds a Naano team that sources creators, writes briefs and runs your campaigns end to end.

 	Self-Serve	Managed Campaigns
Price	€0 / month	€700 / month
What's included	Creator marketplace access, AI-powered brief creation, click/lead/pipeline tracking, automatic creator payouts	Campaign strategy & positioning, creator sourcing & coordination, brief creation & launch, reporting & optimisation
Creator payment	You book the creator's published fixed-price offer	Naano manages creator payments on your behalf
Support	Self-serve platform, help center + email	Dedicated Naano team, book a campaign call
	Start for free
	Book a campaign call

Campaign spend is separate from the plan fee. No lock-in, cancel anytime.

HOW IT WORKS

How per-post pricing works

Marketplace offers use a fixed price chosen by the creator. The amount and included deliverables are visible before you book; there is no cost per click, impression, or lead.

You review and approve the content a creator submits. Once approved, the post goes live and payment is released to the creator automatically through Stripe Connect, invoices and approvals are handled for you inside the platform.

On Self-Serve there is no platform retainer; you fund the offers you choose. On Managed Campaigns, creator spend remains separate and the €700 monthly fee covers the Naano team running the campaign for you.

Pricing FAQ
What's the minimum budget to start on Naano?

Self-Serve is €0 per month. Creator spend depends on the offers you book, and the exact fixed price is shown before you commit.

How much does a single post cost?

Each creator sets a fixed price for their offer. You see the amount and included deliverables before booking; there is no cost per click or impression.

Can I upgrade to Managed Campaigns or cancel anytime?

Yes. Both plans are month-to-month with no lock-in. You can move from Self-Serve to Managed Campaigns, downgrade, or cancel whenever you like. Campaign spend is always separate from the plan fee.

How do creator payouts work?

The challenge

Before Naano, BlogSEO had already tested influencer marketing. They paid €2,000 for a single sponsored post and generated only three sign-ups.

The conclusion was simple: creator marketing looked expensive, difficult to track, and impossible to scale with confidence.

They didn't need more reach. They needed a predictable way to find relevant creators, activate them at scale, and turn engagement into pipeline.

Old approach

one sponsored post
Result

02
The campaign

BlogSEO launched a LinkedIn creator campaign with Naano, matched with ~10 relevant creators and a €5,000 budget.

Over the campaign, creators published around 15 posts designed to reach BlogSEO's target audience and generate qualified demand. Every post was tracked through Naano, so the team could see which creators and which content generated real commercial intent.

Creator campaign post
Tracked in Naano · LinkedIn

"I fired my SEO agency. An AI agent now runs it.", one of the creator posts that drove qualified demand for BlogSEO.

View one of the posts
03
The results

For BlogSEO, the value wasn't just visibility. The campaign created a structured list of people who had engaged, 1,500+ qualified leads surfaced in the dashboard, ready to reactivate through outbound.

Instead of treating creator marketing as an awareness play, the team could connect creator content to leads, conversations, and revenue, landing at 150% ROAS.

04
Why it worked

The difference wasn't spending more on creators. Naano made the campaign operational.

Relevant creator matching instead of one expensive bet on a single influencer
Multiple posts and angles instead of relying on one piece of content
Centralized tracking across the entire campaign
Qualified lead extraction directly into a dashboard
